properties.description: The changelog draft is DERIVED and says so: buckets are mapped from graph vocabulary rather than guessed, the [Unreleased] window is everything after the last DEPLOYED release, an empty delta renders as an empty draft rather than an invented entry, and the output is a DRAFT — no entry claims what a consumer should do, because the graph cannot know it. PLANNED, written before the build so the shape of the proof is settled first.
properties.name: The changelog draft is derived from the graph, and says it is a draft
